review: 303.4d: skip reason was wrong (Mycosynth Lattice plus March of the Machines turns an Aura into a creature); added scenario 303.4d-1 and removed the skip.
303.4h: skip reason rewritten to name the CopyPermanent attach effects (Arna Kennerud, Stangg), which copy only permanents already attached.

303.4i-1 (Retether): Retether chooses the object on resolution under an extra restriction, which is 303.4g (no legal object under the enchant ability and other applicable effects), not 303.4i; renamed 303.4g-2 and moved the attach choice from the variant delta into the decisions.
303.4i-1: replaced with Academy Researchers, whose effect names the object the Aura enters attached to; Wild Growth versus Holy Strength.

303.4j-1: Aura Graft says 'another permanent it can enchant', so choosing Black Knight was never a legal choice and the base did not reach 303.4j; switched to Enchantment Alteration (attach to another creature, no can-enchant restriction) and made the minimal pair the identity of the only other creature.

skipped.reason: cannot be illustrated in Forge: every script that puts a card onto the battlefield attached to something (AttachedTo$ on ChangeZone, Token or CopyPermanent) selects Aura, Equipment or Role cards, or copies a permanent that is already attached (Arna Kennerud, Stangg), which can only be an Aura, Equipment or Fortification

scenarios.title: An enchantment can be cast only in a main phase of its controller's turn with an empty stack

setup.notes: Both players have 20 life, nobody has cast anything this turn, and A has priority.

decisions: The candidate action is A casting Glorious Anthem from hand, paying {1}{W}{W} with the three Plains.
Only the legality verdict of the cast is recorded; whether it is legal decides whether A makes it.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Casting Glorious Anthem is legal: can_play is true, because it is A's main phase, A has priority and the stack is empty.

variants.label: combat-step
variants.delta: The step is beginning_of_combat instead of main1.
variants.expected: Casting Glorious Anthem is not legal: can_play is false and the card stays in A's hand.

operation.unclassifiable: phase or turn: the step is beginning of combat instead of main1

variants.label: opponent-turn
variants.delta: B is the active player in main1 instead of A, and A holds priority after B passes.
variants.expected: Casting Glorious Anthem is not legal: can_play is false, because it is not A's turn.

operation.unclassifiable: phase or turn: B is the active player instead of A

variants.label: stack-not-empty
variants.delta: A first casts Shock targeting B with the Mountain, and A holds priority with Shock still on the stack.
variants.expected: Casting Glorious Anthem is not legal: can_play is false while Shock is on the stack, and no mana from the Plains is spent.

operation.unclassifiable: timing: Shock is on the stack from a spell A cast

detector.outcome: A decision candidate's timing bit is true: for an enchantment or any other spell without flash, its controller has priority in a main phase of their own turn with an empty stack.
detector.near_miss: A decision candidate whose timing bit is false: another step, another player's turn, or a non-empty stack.

scenarios.title: A resolving enchantment spell enters the battlefield under its controller's control

setup.notes: Grizzly Bears has been under A's control since before the turn.

decisions: A casts Glorious Anthem, tapping the three Plains.
A passes priority; B passes priority; Glorious Anthem resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Glorious Anthem moves from the stack to the battlefield under A's control, and Grizzly Bears is a 3/3.

variants.label: countered
variants.delta: After A passes priority B casts Counterspell targeting Glorious Anthem, tapping both Islands, then both players pass.
variants.expected: Glorious Anthem is countered and goes from the stack to A's graveyard without entering the battlefield; Counterspell goes to B's graveyard; Grizzly Bears stays a 2/2.

operation.unclassifiable: choice: B casts Counterspell, a different spell, in response

detector.outcome: A resolving permanent spell moves from the stack to the battlefield.
detector.near_miss: A permanent spell that leaves the stack without entering the battlefield (countered); not counted: a permanent spell's implicit trait has no line, so no api can be set.

scenarios.title: A resolving Aura spell enters the battlefield attached to the object it targeted
decisions: A casts Pacifism targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping the two Plains.
A passes priority; B passes priority; Pacifism resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Pacifism enters the battlefield under A's control attached to B's Grizzly Bears, which stays on the battlefield.

variants.label: target-gone
variants.delta: Holding priority after casting Pacifism, A casts Shock targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping the Mountain, then both players pass until both spells have resolved.
variants.expected: Shock resolves first and Grizzly Bears moves to B's graveyard; Pacifism has no legal target, does not enter the battlefield and goes from the stack to A's graveyard.

operation.unclassifiable: timing: A casts Shock while Pacifism is on the stack

detector.outcome: An Aura entering the battlefield from a resolution is attached to an object or player as it enters: an attached event in the effect half.
detector.near_miss: An Aura spell that leaves the stack without entering attached (its target became illegal); not counted: an Aura spell's implicit permanent trait has no line, so no api can be set.

scenarios.title: An Aura spell can be cast only if its enchant ability has a legal target
decisions: The candidate action is A casting Pacifism, paying {1}{W} with the two Plains.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Casting Pacifism is legal: can_play is true, has_legal_target is true and the legal targets are Grizzly Bears.

variants.label: no-creature
variants.delta: B controls no creature, so Grizzly Bears is absent from the battlefield.
variants.expected: Casting Pacifism is not legal: has_legal_target is false, there are no legal targets and can_play is false.

variants.label: protection
variants.delta: B's only creature is Black Knight (protection from white) instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Casting Pacifism is not legal: Black Knight is not a legal target of the white Aura, has_legal_target is false and can_play is false.

detector.outcome: A targeted spell candidate has a legal target, so it is playable.
detector.near_miss: A targeted spell candidate with no legal target.

scenarios.title: An Aura whose enchanted object has left the battlefield is put into its owner's graveyard

setup.notes: Pacifism has been attached to B's Grizzly Bears since an earlier turn; A controls it.

decisions: A casts Shock targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping the Mountain.
A passes priority; B passes priority; Shock resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is dealt 2 damage and moves to B's graveyard in the state-based check; Pacifism, no longer attached to anything, moves from the battlefield to A's graveyard in the same check.

variants.label: tougher
variants.delta: B's creature is Centaur Courser (3/3), the Aura's enchanted object, instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Centaur Courser stays on the battlefield with 2 damage marked and Pacifism stays attached to it.

detector.outcome: An Aura whose host left the battlefield in the record moves to its owner's graveyard in the state-based check.
detector.near_miss: An Aura whose host the record touched and which stayed attached on the battlefield.

scenarios.title: An Aura enchanting an object it can no longer legally enchant is put into its owner's graveyard

setup.notes: Pacifism is white and controlled by A; it has been attached to B's Grizzly Bears since an earlier turn.

decisions: B casts Gods Willing targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping the Plains, and chooses the color white.
B passes priority; A passes priority; Gods Willing resolves (B scries 1 and leaves the card on top).

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears gains protection from white until end of turn and Pacifism, which it can no longer legally enchant, moves from the battlefield to A's graveyard in the state-based check.

variants.label: other-color
variants.delta: B chooses the color red instead of white.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears gains protection from red until end of turn and Pacifism stays on the battlefield attached to it.

operation.unclassifiable: choice: B chooses red instead of white

detector.outcome: An Aura whose host left the battlefield or gained protection from one of the Aura's colours moves to its owner's graveyard in the state-based check after the resolution.
detector.near_miss: An Aura whose host the resolution touched stays legal and stays on the battlefield.

scenarios.title: An Aura that becomes a creature becomes unattached and is put into its owner's graveyard

setup.notes: Mycosynth Lattice has been on the battlefield since an earlier turn, so every permanent is already an artifact. A cast Pacifism on B's Grizzly Bears on an earlier turn.

decisions: A casts March of the Machines, tapping the four Islands.
A passes priority; B passes priority; March of the Machines resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Pacifism, a noncreature artifact through Mycosynth Lattice, becomes a 2/2 artifact creature Aura; in the state-based check it becomes unattached and moves to A's graveyard. The four Islands become 0/0 artifact creatures and move to A's graveyard in the same check. Mycosynth Lattice is a 6/6 and March of the Machines a 4/4; Grizzly Bears stays a 2/2.

variants.label: no-lattice
variants.delta: Mycosynth Lattice is absent from A's battlefield.
variants.expected: Pacifism is not an artifact, does not become a creature and stays attached to Grizzly Bears; the Islands stay on the battlefield.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge's stateBasedAction704_attach unattaches an attached permanent that is a creature; the unattached Aura then goes to the graveyard. The self-enchanting half of 303.4d stays unreachable: no Forge effect attaches an Aura to itself.

scenarios.title: Only the Aura's controller can activate the Aura's own abilities, though it enchants another player's creature

setup.notes: A cast Crown of Flames on B's Grizzly Bears on an earlier turn: A controls the Aura and B controls the creature. A has priority with an empty stack, and B has priority too after A passes.

decisions: The candidate action is A activating Crown of Flames' ability '{R}: Enchanted creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn', paying {R} with an untapped Mountain.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: The activation is legal: can_play is true for A, whose Mountain pays {R}, and the enchanted Grizzly Bears would get +1/+0.

variants.label: creature-controller
variants.delta: The candidate is B, the controller of the enchanted creature, activating the same ability and paying {R} with B's Mountain.
variants.expected: The activation is not legal: can_play is false for B, because B does not control Crown of Flames.

operation.unclassifiable: choice: B instead of A attempts to activate Crown of Flames' ability

detector.outcome: The controller of an Aura can activate the Aura's own ability: the candidate's can_play bit is true.
detector.near_miss: A player who does not control the Aura has a false can_play bit for its ability.

scenarios.title: An ability an Aura grants can be activated only by the enchanted creature's controller

setup.notes: A cast Archery Training on B's Grizzly Bears on an earlier turn and it has one arrow counter. A's Centaur Courser has been declared as an attacker and is tapped and attacking. The declare-attackers step is over and priority is with the player named in the candidate.

decisions: The candidate action is B activating the ability Archery Training grants to Grizzly Bears, '{T}: This creature deals X damage to target attacking or blocking creature', targeting Centaur Courser, where X is the number of arrow counters on Archery Training.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: The activation is legal: can_play is true for B, with Centaur Courser as a legal target.

variants.label: aura-controller
variants.delta: The candidate is A, who controls Archery Training but not Grizzly Bears, attempting the same activation.
variants.expected: The activation is not legal: can_play is false for A, because the granted ability belongs to Grizzly Bears and A does not control it.

operation.unclassifiable: choice: A instead of B attempts to activate the ability Archery Training grants Grizzly Bears

scenarios.forge_notes: Centaur Courser must be set up as a declared attacker, which a tapped flag alone does not express.

detector.outcome: The controller of the enchanted creature can activate an ability the Aura grants it: can_play is true.
detector.near_miss: A player who does not control the enchanted creature has a false can_play bit for the granted ability.

scenarios.title: Changing control of the enchanted creature does not change control of the Aura

setup.notes: B cast Crown of Flames on B's own Grizzly Bears on an earlier turn. Once Act of Treason has resolved A has priority with an empty stack in main1; A has one untapped Mountain and B has one untapped Mountain.

decisions: A casts Act of Treason targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping three Mountains.
A passes priority; B passes priority; Act of Treason resolves and A controls Grizzly Bears until end of turn.
The candidate action is B activating Crown of Flames' ability '{R}: Enchanted creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn', paying {R} with B's untapped Mountain.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Crown of Flames is still controlled by B and the activation is legal: can_play is true for B, even though A now controls the enchanted Grizzly Bears.

variants.label: creature-controller
variants.delta: The candidate is A, the new controller of the enchanted creature, activating the same ability and paying {R} with A's fourth Mountain.
variants.expected: The activation is not legal: can_play is false for A, because control of Crown of Flames did not change.

operation.unclassifiable: choice: A instead of B attempts to activate Crown of Flames' ability

detector.outcome: The Aura's controller can still activate its ability after control of the enchanted permanent changed: can_play is true.
detector.near_miss: The player who gained the enchanted permanent has a false can_play bit for the Aura's ability.

scenarios.title: An Aura entering the battlefield with nothing legal to enchant stays in its zone

setup.notes: No creature is on the battlefield in the base.

decisions: A casts Replenish, tapping the four Plains.
A passes priority; B passes priority; Replenish resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Pacifism has no legal creature to enchant, stays in A's graveyard and does not enter the battlefield; Replenish goes to A's graveyard.

variants.label: creature-present
variants.delta: B controls a Grizzly Bears, and A chooses it as the object Pacifism enters attached to.
variants.expected: Pacifism moves from A's graveyard to the battlefield attached to Grizzly Bears; Replenish goes to A's graveyard.

scenarios.forge_notes: Whether Forge leaves an Aura with nothing to enchant in the graveyard when Replenish resolves is the behaviour under test; the base has no creature on either side.

detector.none: No record field or event shows the outcome: the Aura stays where it was, so the resolution holds no zone_change or attached event for it, indistinguishable from any resolution that does not touch it (looked at EVENT_PARAMS zone_change and attached, and the effect half).

scenarios.title: An Aura that an effect restricts to creatures, but that cannot enchant a creature, stays in its zone

setup.notes: Retether returns each Aura card from A's graveyard and allows only creatures to be enchanted this way; lands, which Wild Growth could otherwise enchant, are on the battlefield.

decisions: A casts Retether, tapping four Plains.
A passes priority; B passes priority; Retether resolves.
If an Aura can enter, A attaches it to Grizzly Bears, the only creature.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Wild Growth (enchant land) cannot enchant a creature, stays in A's graveyard and does not enter the battlefield; Retether goes to A's graveyard.

variants.label: creature-aura
variants.delta: The Aura card in A's graveyard is Pacifism instead of Wild Growth.
variants.expected: Pacifism moves from A's graveyard to the battlefield attached to Grizzly Bears; Retether goes to A's graveyard.

detector.none: No record field or event shows the outcome: the Aura stays where it was, so the resolution holds no zone_change or attached event for it, indistinguishable from any resolution that does not touch it (looked at EVENT_PARAMS zone_change and attached, and the effect half).

scenarios.title: An Aura put onto the battlefield attached to an object it cannot legally enchant stays in its zone

setup.notes: A has priority with an empty stack.

decisions: A casts Academy Researchers, tapping the three Islands; both players pass and it resolves.
Its enters trigger goes on the stack; both players pass and it resolves.
A chooses to put the Aura card in hand onto the battlefield attached to Academy Researchers.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Wild Growth (enchant land) cannot enchant Academy Researchers and stays in A's hand; Academy Researchers is a 2/2 with nothing attached.

variants.label: creature-aura
variants.delta: The Aura card in A's hand is Holy Strength instead of Wild Growth.
variants.expected: Holy Strength moves from A's hand to the battlefield attached to Academy Researchers, which is a 3/4.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge offers only Auras that can enchant Academy Researchers (ChangeType$ Aura.CanEnchantSource), so in the base no card is offered and Wild Growth stays in hand.

detector.none: No record field or event shows the outcome: the Aura stays where it was, so the resolution holds no zone_change or attached event for it, indistinguishable from any resolution that does not touch it (looked at EVENT_PARAMS zone_change and attached, and the effect half).

scenarios.title: An effect attaching an Aura to an object it cannot legally enchant leaves the Aura where it is

setup.notes: B cast Pacifism on A's Grizzly Bears on an earlier turn. Black Knight (protection from white) is the only other creature on the battlefield.

decisions: A casts Enchantment Alteration targeting Pacifism, tapping the Island.
A passes priority; B passes priority; Enchantment Alteration resolves and A chooses B's other creature as the permanent to attach Pacifism to.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Pacifism cannot legally enchant Black Knight and does not move: it stays attached to Grizzly Bears under B's control; Enchantment Alteration goes to A's graveyard.

variants.label: legal-creature
variants.delta: B's other creature is Centaur Courser instead of Black Knight.
variants.expected: Pacifism moves from Grizzly Bears to Centaur Courser; Enchantment Alteration goes to A's graveyard.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge may offer only permanents Pacifism can enchant; with Black Knight as the only other creature it then offers none, and Pacifism still does not move.

detector.outcome: An attach effect resolves without moving its Aura, because the object or player it would attach to can't legally be enchanted: the attach resolution's effect half holds no attached event.
detector.near_miss: An attach effect resolves and moves the Aura to its new object or player: an attached event in the effect half.

scenarios.title: A permanent with two Roles controlled by the same player keeps only the newest one

setup.notes: Grizzly Bears has been under A's control since before the turn.

decisions: A casts Monstrous Rage targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping a Mountain; both players pass; it resolves and A's Monster Role token enters attached to Grizzly Bears.
A casts the second Monstrous Rage targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping the second Mountain; both players pass; it resolves and A's second Monster Role token enters attached to Grizzly Bears.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: A controls two Roles on Grizzly Bears; the first Monster Role token is put into A's graveyard in the state-based check and ceases to exist, the second stays; Grizzly Bears is a 7/3 with trample until end of turn.

variants.label: other-controller
variants.delta: B casts B's own Monstrous Rage targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping B's Mountain, instead of A casting the second one; the second Role token is B's.
variants.expected: Each Role is controlled by a different player, so both Monster Role tokens stay attached to Grizzly Bears, which is an 8/4 with trample until end of turn.

operation.unclassifiable: choice: B casts the second Monstrous Rage instead of A
